name: valorant
aspect_notes: Approximate 16:9 search regions, not pixel-exact UI contracts. Native 16:10/ultrawide retains height-relative HUD size with left/right/center anchors; stretched or customized HUDs need calibration. For pillarbox/letterbox footage use pixels(..., letterboxed=True) or crop to the content first. UI scale, patches and spectator overlays can shift regions.
alive_rules: Crosshair, ability bar, positive health and ammo, and direct mouse-look control together support alive state.
dead_rules: Right-side COMBAT REPORT or KILLED BY panel; a teammate first-person view does not prove the recorder is alive.
spectating_rules: GHOST PLAYER label, teammate cycling panel, or another player name with a combat report.
highlights: Clutches, aces, confirmed rapid multikills, spike plants/defuses under pressure.
lowlights: Whiffed shots, failed utility, exposed positioning, or a failed defuse causing a loss.
